constraints.snippet: Hybrid facilities (large load plus generation, storage, etc.) are handled by placing requirements on the plant as a whole.
constraints.notes: Qualitative plant-level interconnection compliance rule for hybrid large-load facilities in Germany.

constraints.snippet: Voltage regulation settings and software status must be defined and "traceable."
constraints.notes: Qualitative voltage regulation and traceability requirement from German electrolysis connection code review.

constraints.snippet: ROCOF ride through requirements that do not restrict participation in load shedding.
constraints.notes: Qualitative rate-of-change-of-frequency (ROCOF) ride-through obligation; no numeric ROCOF value is provided on this page.

constraints.snippet: Maximum short-circuit ride-through capability is specified by the Transmission System Operator (TSO).
constraints.notes: Qualitative short-circuit ride-through obligation; TSO provides maximum and minimum short-circuit current estimates and specifies maximum short-circuit current the load must ride through.

constraints.snippet: "Appropriate and proportionate" compliance testing is required In accordance with Article 37(1)(b) of Directive 2009/72/EC
constraints.notes: Procedural compliance testing obligation under the ENTSO-E Demand Connection Code.

constraints.snippet: Protection requirements (protection takes precedence over controls)
constraints.notes: Qualitative protection hierarchy requirement alongside general frequency, general voltage, short circuit, and reactive power requirement categories in the ENTSO-E code.

constraints.snippet: Implement new demand forecasts including price responsive forecasts and require large loads (over 25 MW) to provide additional information to ERCOT
constraints.source_section: ERCOT's Proposed Large Load Connection Requirements
constraints.notes: Proposed qualitative load forecasting and information requirement for ERCOT large loads over 25 MW (applicability threshold, not a power-variation limit).

constraints.snippet: Implement a new voltage ride-through standard for loads larger than 75 MW. Utilize IEEE 1668 criteria as a starting point
constraints.source_section: ERCOT's Proposed Large Load Connection Requirements
constraints.notes: Proposed voltage ride-through standard for ERCOT loads larger than 75 MW referencing IEEE 1668 criteria; no numeric power-variation limit specified.

constraints.snippet: ERCOT proposes that large, power electronic–based loads must use constant current control and may not use constant power control, s proposal adapted from NERC, the California Mobility Center, and the Western Electricity Coordinating Council’s EV Charging Recommendations
constraints.source_section: ERCOT's Proposed Large Load Connection Requirements
constraints.notes: Proposed qualitative control mode requirement for large power electronic-based loads in ERCOT.
